locks.doc: Blocking startup-migration lock for keycustodian_db. Held by AdvisoryLockMigrator during ensure-db + MigrateAsync. Separate key from ROTATION so the migrator and the rotation timer never block each other.

Try-lock guarding unattended rotation ticks for keycustodian_db. Held by KeyRotationService for the duration of one RunDueRotations invocation. Skip-if-held semantics prevent two instances from running simultaneous rotations.

Try-lock guarding startup certificate-authority seeding for keycustodian_db. Held by CaSeedingService while it seeds the root + intermediate from the CA provider. Separate key from MIGRATOR and ROTATION; skip-if-held semantics ensure exactly one instance seeds across a multi-instance deployment.
